call_points.text: Same-store sales growth reached 17.8% in Q4, supported by healthy store footfalls and wedding season demand.
Full-year EBITDA margin expanded to 19% from 17.5% in FY25 due to operating leverage and cost efficiencies.
The company ended the year with 223 exclusive showrooms across 161 cities and plans further store expansion.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹2 per equity share on a face value of ₹2.
GST reduction on footwear below ₹2,500 served as a meaningful volume catalyst.
Channel mix stands at approximately 70% offline retail and 30% online through marketplaces.
Pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin is around 16.4%.
